capture.captureRecipe: Detached worktree at commit 658b36ef0f559fe11f712c5c9ae2b026b6eb87c2, served by Vite on loopback; Playwright viewport 1440x900 locale en-US with deviceScaleFactor 2 (PNG is 2880x1800); click the first .tp-daily-choice; scroll .tp-daily-case to top; screenshot. The annotated frame draws its boxes from getBoundingClientRect of .tp-daily-transcript, .tp-daily-suspects and .tp-daily-choice-grid, so callouts are measured rather than drawn by eye. The daily puzzle rotates by date, so no caption names a specific alias.
